missions.purpose: To gain a first hands-on programming experience and collect enough information to choose a suitable next learning path.
missions.description: Open an online Python editor such as Python Tutor or Replit. Spend 30–45 minutes learning just enough Python to create and run a program that asks for a name and age, then prints a greeting and a message stating whether the person is under or over 18. Save the code and briefly note what felt interesting, confusing, or frustrating.
definition_of_done: You have opened an online Python coding environment and run code successfully.
Your program accepts a name and an age as input.
Your program prints a personalized greeting.
Your program uses a condition to give different output for an age below 18 and an age of 18 or above.
You have written down one aspect you enjoyed and one question or difficulty you encountered.
